title: Power Apps: Dataverse custom APIs in generative pages
summary: The briefing passes: the feature behaviour, security qualifications and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should describe the roadmap dates as targets, reflect the published product-level licensing, clarify the general Copilot control's reach and explain that the export path opens the configuration wizard.

claims.claim: The tenant Copilot preview control is at Power Platform admin center > Settings > Tenant settings > Copilot in Power Apps (preview).
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Settings to open the Tenant settings page. Select Copilot in Power Apps (preview), and then set the toggle to Off.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented an automation call for the tenant Copilot in Power Apps preview control.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot in Power Apps preview tenant settings PowerShell Set-TenantSettings powerApps copilot; "Copilot in Power Apps" "powerApps" "tenant" "settings" API. Read Set-TenantSettings, List tenant settings and pac admin; no property documented for this preview switch.

claims.claim: This is a general maker Copilot preview control whose effect on custom API use and published-page calls is not confirmed.
claims.quote: Copilot preview features are on by default, but your admin can turn them off for an environment or a tenant. Turning off Copilot for your tenant turns off Copilot for makers only.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence of controls[0].note, including its rendered copy, with: 'Controls Copilot preview features for makers in the tenant; Microsoft does not document it as a switch for custom API calls from published generative pages.' Retain the alternate Tenant settings route.

claims.claim: Tenant settings can also be reached through Manage > Tenant settings.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Tenant settings.

claims.claim: Application Insights export configuration is reached through Power Platform admin center > Manage > Data export > App Insights > New data export.
claims.quote: In the navigation pane, select Manage. In the Manage pane, select Data export. On the Data export page, select the App Insights tab. Then select New data export.
claims.fix: Keep the path and add to controls[1].note and its rendered copy: 'This opens the export wizard; select the data type and filters, the source environment, and the destination Azure subscription, resource group and Application Insights environment to complete configuration.' The remaining steps are documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/set-up-export-application-insights#create-an-export-package.

claims.claim: Dataverse plug-in code can run in another user's context.
claims.quote: Sometimes you need the code in a plug-in to run in the context of a different user, for example to perform an operation on their behalf. There are two ways to apply impersonation in plug-ins: at registration or execution.
